home.title: Front-End Developer
home.description: I specialize in building modern, responsive, and interactive web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. With an engineering background and a passion for technology, I turn ideas into functional and engaging digital experiences.

about.title: About Me
description: I'm a Front-End Developer with a background in Electronics Engineering and a strong passion for technology, problem-solving, and continuous learning.

My engineering background has shaped the way I approach challenges. It has strengthened my analytical and critical thinking skills, taught me to pay attention to detail, and helped me develop a structured approach to identifying problems, evaluating different solutions, and making thoughtful decisions.

I enjoy turning ideas into functional, responsive, and engaging web applications. Working with technologies like React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS allows me to combine logical thinking with creativity to build intuitive user interfaces and meaningful digital experiences.

I value clean, maintainable code, continuous improvement, and staying curious about emerging technologies. I believe that becoming a great developer is an ongoing journey that requires curiosity, adaptability, critical thinking, and a genuine commitment to learning.

ems.title: Employee Management System
ems.description: A nearly full-stack Employee Management System built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It features role-based access for Admin and Employee users, employee management, authentication, and payroll functionality, including salary calculations and payslip generation. Built with internal API routes and JSON Server as a local database, the project demonstrates practical full-stack development concepts.
